title: Same-origin policy and CORS
description: Apply the browser same-origin model and reason about preflight, explicit origins and credentials without disabling browser protections.
objectives: Define an origin using scheme host and port
Distinguish cross-origin requests from cross-origin response access
Explain CORS preflight and credential rules
Reject wildcard ACAO with credentials in a local policy exercise
rubric: I identified scheme, host and port as origin components.
I rejected wildcard CORS with credentials and accepted explicit match.
I explained preflight and why CORS is not authentication.
